note: The salon of the Maison de Couture: manners, beauty, looks and charm. The marble column in the middle divides it: feminine nouns on its left, masculine (and chic) on its right. The blank wall panel opens a zoom onto the dressing corner (R_abs_beauty_02_z1). The glazed door on the far left leads out to the square; the doorway on the far right leads on to the showroom atelier.
